question: A journey of 900 km is completed in 11 h. If two-fifth of the journey is completed at the speed of 60 km/h, at what speed (in km/h) is the remaining journey completed?
solution:
**Given:**

The total time to cover 900 km = 11 h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Time is taken to cover two-fifth of the journey = [(2/5) × 900]/60 = 360/60 = 6 h

The speed of the remaining distance = (900 - 360)/(11 - 6)

= 540/5 km/h

= 108 km/h

**∴ The speed of the remaining journey is 108 km/h**
